title: If you build your own, this is the part that transfers
headSub: None of it is about this app. It is what building it with an AI taught me about building anything with one.

cards.label: Start with a need
lines: a clear purpose and a defined outcome
not because agents are in fashion

cards.label: Adopt with guardrails
lines: from day one, not bolted on later

cards.label: Decide the autonomy
lines: how much the AI does on its own
and where the human's call has to sit

cards.label: Build for the problem
lines: leave out what it does not need
context decides, and context can change

cards.label: Keep review
lines: now that the model writes the code

takeaway.text: The model is a tool, a powerful one. {{blue:Judgment, clear specs, review, and restraint are the job now.}}
